findings.value: A café by day and a hi-fi listening bar and disco by night on Brick Lane, broadcasting as Radio 1001.

evidence.quote: A combined Café, cocktail bar, lounge and disco.
Our love for music allowed Radio 1001 to be born, an incubator for talent new and established and a platform for DJs to showcase their talents.
Cafe 1001 has served as a cultural anchor in London for 25 years.

findings.value: Time Out says people come to check emails by day and to drink and hear a DJ after dark.

evidence.quote: who gather to check emails by day, then glug lager and catch a DJ after dark
The space features a wide-ranging programme including house, disco, funk, balearic, broken beat, and UK Garage.

findings.value: DJ sets and listening parties, with sets recorded for its Radio 1001 channel.

evidence.quote: All our sets are recorded and can be listened back to via archive below or on our YouTube channel.
Expect regular listening parties, DJ sets, and events like the midweek BYOV sessions.

notes: Time Out's page (1 Feb 2022) is a review; its address and hours are facts for the facts aspect. The venue's site lists opening hours and says it works with DJs; no closure news. Songkick is refused and not used.
